description: Fewer Mouse Picks When Still, click correctness: camera and mouse still for 6 s before each of 6 screen points (spread over the default view, where Sims, objects and floor sit), then 3 left clicks each (Esc after each closes a pie menu), 18 in all. Pass: on logs clicks held for a new pick with 0 timed out and picks skipped while still, off logs no skip line. The runner cannot yet read the hover, the pie menu or the selected target, nor aim at a named Sim, so same target in off and on is a screenshot compare by hand until the agent has a pick-result command; the case of a Sim walking under a still mouse (hover must update) is not drivable yet either.

expect: [PickReadback] Last d+ s: d+ picks, [1-9]d* skipped with nothing changed
[PickReadback] Last d+ s: .*[1-9]d* clicks held for a new pick (d+ ms, 0 timed out)
fail: d+ clicks held for a new pick (d+ ms, [1-9]d* timed out)
